verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows an Appwrite policy, setting, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The related items are adjacent controls rather than a training opt-out: self-hosting with 'full control over data location', SOC-2/HIPAA compliance, and stripping image metadata. Because this privacy-posture question fairly applies to a backend-as-a-service, the lack of evidence makes the verdict 'none', not 'na'.
